const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""RoboPaint strict controller for the six exemplar strokes in target.png.
+
+Run with --practice to ink the brush and make pressure samples on the free
+practice page; --write executes the final six main-page strokes.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+import argparse, json, math, os, sys
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+Q_DOWN = np.array([0., 1., 0., 0.], dtype=float)
+DT = .05
+MAIN_SURFACE = .020
+PRACTICE_SURFACE = .020
+MAIN_CENTER = (-.100, 0.)
+PRACTICE_CENTER = (-.100, -.1856)
+WELL_CENTER = (-.100, .150)
+
+def P(x, y, z):
+    return np.r_[np.asarray([x, y, z], dtype=float), Q_DOWN]
+
+class PathBuilder:
+    def __init__(self, start):
+        self.pos = np.asarray(start[:3], dtype=float)
+        self.rows = []
+    def go(self, xyz, spacing=.005, dwell=0):
+        dst = np.asarray(xyz, dtype=float)
+        d = float(np.linalg.norm(dst-self.pos))
+        n = max(1, int(math.ceil(d/spacing)))
+        for i in range(1, n+1):
+            self.rows.append(P(*(self.pos + (dst-self.pos)*(i/n))))
+        self.pos = dst
+        for _ in range(dwell): self.rows.append(P(*self.pos))
+    def follow(self, points, spacing=.003):
+        for xyz in points[1:]: self.go(xyz, spacing=spacing)
+    def array(self):
+        return np.asarray(self.rows, dtype=np.float32)
+
+def bezier(a,b,c,d,n=60):
+    a,b,c,d = map(lambda x: np.asarray(x,dtype=float), (a,b,c,d))
+    t=np.linspace(0.,1.,n)
+    return ((1-t)**3)[:,None]*a + (3*(1-t)**2*t)[:,None]*b + (3*(1-t)*t**2)[:,None]*c + (t**3)[:,None]*d
+
+def paper_xy(u, v):
+    """Target pixel centre to world XY; image top is far edge, left is +y."""
+    mm=.227185/1024
+    return (.0135925-(v+.5)*mm, .1135925-(u+.5)*mm)
+
+def append_stroke(b, world_path, z, travel_z=.070, surface=MAIN_SURFACE):
+    # world_path is a sequence of (x,y); approach and leave vertically so every
+    # main-sheet contact belongs to this one intended centreline.
+    x0,y0=world_path[0]; x1,y1=world_path[-1]
+    b.go((x0,y0,travel_z))
+    b.go((x0,y0,z))
+    b.follow([(x,y,z) for x,y in world_path], spacing=.0027)
+    b.go((x1,y1,travel_z))
+
+def create_final_builder(start):
+    b=PathBuilder(start)
+    # Six regular-script strokes, traced along each exemplar stroke's medial
+    # direction. Target image coordinates are converted directly to the paper.
+    pixel_paths = [
+        # Water radical: first short dot, drawn with its natural down-right sweep.
+        bezier((339,267),(347,272),(381,312),(398,327),18),
+        # Second dot.
+        bezier((282,405),(291,407),(324,444),(338,457),18),
+        # Long falling stroke with the heavier turn and finish of the exemplar.
+        np.vstack([bezier((407,500),(389,523),(327,612),(300,649),30),
+                   bezier((300,649),(284,662),(289,707),(309,725),20)[1:]]),
+        # 工: upper horizontal, left to right.
+        bezier((472,386),(514,414),(677,354),(720,348),50),
+        # 工: vertical begins at the top-bar junction and falls straight down.
+        np.vstack([bezier((568,393),(583,399),(601,413),(605,429),12),
+                   bezier((605,429),(593,459),(584,544),(579,612),40)[1:]]),
+        # 工: lower horizontal, with the slightly hooked broad entry.
+        np.vstack([bezier((390,638),(399,654),(421,665),(447,654),18),
+                   bezier((447,654),(526,637),(693,623),(790,624),55)[1:]]),
+    ]
+    # Moderate press: approximately 4.5 mm below the paper plane, tuned on the
+    # practice sheet. The taper at short dot endpoints is represented by extra
+    # pressure at their middle, while remaining a single longitudinal path.
+    depths=[.0148,.0148,.0145,.0147,.0145,.0147]
+    for pix,z in zip(pixel_paths,depths):
+        xy=[paper_xy(float(u),float(v)) for u,v in pix]
+        append_stroke(b,xy,z)
+    b.go((-.100,0.,.090), spacing=.006)
+    return b
+
+def go_to_surface(r, b, x,y,surface,z):
+    b.go((x,y,.070)); b.go((x,y,z));
+
+def submit_rows(r, rows, note, cameras=None, video='none'):
+    # Keep each action within the service's 10 s / 400 row call limit.
+    rows=np.asarray(rows,dtype=np.float32)
+    for lo in range(0,len(rows),190):
+        res=r.submit('ee_pose',rows[lo:lo+190],dt=DT,video=video,cameras=cameras,note=note)
+        print(json.dumps({'note':note,'rows':len(rows[lo:lo+190]),'plan':res.meta.get('plan',[])[-3:],
+                          'status':r.status()},default=str),flush=True)
+
+def make_ink_and_practice(r, start):
+    b=PathBuilder(start)
+    # Dip once in the radius-20 mm well, below its ink surface; dwell there to
+    # ensure contact before returning to the free practice sheet.
+    b.go((*WELL_CENTER,.075), spacing=.006)
+    b.go((*WELL_CENTER,.012), spacing=.003, dwell=12)
+    b.go((*WELL_CENTER,.070), spacing=.004)
+    # Three short test marks at increasing press depth on the practice sheet.
+    # The sheet's long direction is world X; stay well within both edges.
+    tests=[(-.170,.019),(-.100,.016),(-.030,.013)]
+    for x,z in tests:
+        y0,y1=-.216,-.166
+        b.go((x,y0,.070)); b.go((x,y0,z))
+        b.go((x,y1,z),spacing=.0025)
+        b.go((x,y1,.070))
+    b.go((-.100,0.,.090),spacing=.006)
+    submit_rows(r,b.array(),'ink and practice pressure calibration',video='mp4')
+
+def main():
+    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument('--practice',action='store_true')
+    ap.add_argument('--write',action='store_true')
+    args=ap.parse_args()
+    r=Robot()
+    obs=r.get_obs(cameras=[],video='none')
+    now=np.asarray(obs.meta['proprio']['now'],dtype=float)
+    start=now[7:14]
+    print('starting tip',start.tolist(),'status',r.status(),flush=True)
+    if args.practice:
+        make_ink_and_practice(r,start)
+        os.makedirs('/app/output/calibration',exist_ok=True)
+        o=r.get_obs(cameras=['practice_cam','side_cam'],depth=True,video='none')
+        from PIL import Image
+        for cam,img in o.last.items(): Image.fromarray(img).save('/app/output/calibration/'+cam+'.png')
+        for cam,d in o.last_depth.items(): np.save('/app/output/calibration/'+cam+'_depth.npy',d)
+        print('calibration images saved; status',r.status(),flush=True)
+    if args.write:
+        now=np.asarray(r.get_obs(cameras=[],video='none').meta['proprio']['now'],dtype=float)
+        b=create_final_builder(now[7:14])
+        print('main trajectory rows',len(b.rows),'duration',len(b.rows)*DT,flush=True)
+        submit_rows(r,b.array(),'six exemplar strokes on main sheet',video='mp4')
+        os.makedirs('/app/output/final',exist_ok=True)
+        o=r.get_obs(cameras=['canvas_cam','side_cam'],depth=True,video='none')
+        from PIL import Image
+        for cam,img in o.last.items(): Image.fromarray(img).save('/app/output/final/'+cam+'.png')
+        for cam,d in o.last_depth.items(): np.save('/app/output/final/'+cam+'_depth.npy',d)
+        print('final images saved; status',r.status(),flush=True)
+    if not args.practice and not args.write:
+        print('choose --practice or --write')
+
+if __name__=='__main__': main()
*** End Patch";
